main.description: On the source host, for the destination of a move migratePrepare started: a part of the group nothing public serves whole. `meta` is a space's meta archive (as com.atproto.space.exportSpaceMeta serves one), `repo` the group's own repo in a space (as com.atproto.space.getRepo does), `blobs` the list of its files and `blob` one of them. Authorized by migratePrepare's token, for an hour.

leaving.description: For a move to a plain PDS: a space's meta archive as a memberspace whose member list is who may use it now, read and write as their roles allow, so that PDS keeps them in without asking this host.
